title: Extract represented-vector norms and normalization
status_detail: Created by the human instruction `create these as tasks`. This records a proposed vector-analysis task only; it does not activate implementation or prescribe one normalization policy for all domains.
objective: Define reusable real and complex represented-vector norm and normalization contracts for eigenpair residuals, axes, trial vectors, and basis columns without treating vectors as matrices.
authorized_scope: After separate explicit activation, define vector norm, unit-vector result, zero-vector failure, unit propagation, and real or complex storage contracts.
Distinguish intrinsic vector normalization from residual scaling and matrix norms.
Migrate actual consumers while preserving deterministic orientation, phase, and retained numerical behavior.
completion_criteria: Vector norms and normalization have explicit typed owners and zero-vector behavior.
Eigenpair residual, axis, trial-vector, and basis-column consumers use the contract only where their semantics agree.
Tests cover real, complex, unit-aware, zero, extreme-scale, and immutable-result behavior.
exclusions: Do not introduce gauge or phase conventions into a generic norm action.
Do not treat normalization as orthogonalization, basis alignment, or scientific validation.
No protected execution, dependency change, release, publication, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
